description: Current XRPL fee tiers in drops with a congestion score. When to use: Before submitting a transaction, to choose a `Fee` and to decide whether the network is congested. Prefer another tool: Not a price feed and not a historical series; it describes the current open ledger only. Example: xrpl_fee {}
name: xrpl_fee

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

base_fee_drops.description: Reference transaction cost, a decimal string in drops (rippled `fee` drops.base_fee)

band.description: Band of the composite score: low below 30, medium below 70, high from 70

load_factor_multiplier.description: The server load factor the score used, decimal string; null when load_factor_assumed is true

score.description: Integer from 0 to 100, the project composite: 0.5 x queue fill (current_queue_size / max_queue_size) + 0.3 x open-ledger fee pressure + 0.2 x load factor pressure; the queue term is 0 when rippled reports no max_queue_size

current_ledger_size.description: Transactions in the current open ledger (rippled current_ledger_size)

escalation_multiplier.description: The open-ledger cost as a multiple of the reference cost, a factor: rippled `fee` levels.open_ledger_level / levels.reference_level, decimal string. It is not rippled's escalationMultiplier, which is the median fee level

expected_ledger_size.description: Transactions rippled expects in the current ledger (rippled expected_ledger_size)

ledger_fill_ratio.description: Open ledger fill, a fraction: current_ledger_size / expected_ledger_size (rippled `fee`), decimal string; null when expected_ledger_size is 0

max_queue_size.description: Most transactions the queue can hold (rippled `fee` max_queue_size), a JSON integer; null when rippled reports no queue maximum

median_fee_drops.description: rippled's escalation multiplier in drops: the median fee level of the last closed ledger, floored at the minimum; it sets no tier

minimum_fee_drops.description: Lowest cost that enters the queue now, a decimal string in drops (rippled `fee` drops.minimum_fee)

open_ledger_fee_drops.description: Lowest cost that enters the open ledger now, a decimal string in drops (rippled `fee` drops.open_ledger_fee)

title: Fee intelligence
